'''Desha Lor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who in [[43 ABY]] was appointed by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] to be the assistant to Daala's assistant, [[Wynn Dorvan]]. As Dorvan had said the day before her appointment that the really did not want an assistant, Daala placed a bouquet of flowers in his office with a note:'Sorry, a favor'.

==Biography==
Lor was born into a family friendly with [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]]. She was a stellar student with no criminal record. She was thought by [[Wynn Dorvan]] to have been selected by Daala because the chief of state felt that Lor, as a female, may not have the chance later in her career, and because she sympathized with her, having been looked down upon during her Imperial career due to her gender.

==Personality and traits==
Desha was eager and hardworking. She was also very compassionate and saw the best in people. Dorvan would sometimes wonder whether anyone was this innocent anymore. She was also a very caring person, as she was horrified at the carnage wrought by Jedi Knight Natua Wan at the Coruscant Livestock Exchange and Exhibition when she succumbed to a mysterious ailment.
